Its cited evidence only indirectly supports the hypothesis—it concerns PGM-free high-entropy spinels rather than PGM atoms on fluorites—and its quantitative thresholds are unsupported, but A is largely an already-established ceria–alumina strategy and its experiment does not actually include the reduced-PGM catalyst needed to test
